verdict.rationale: The only first-party integration in the evidence is Mailchimp for Magento, a free connector that syncs customers and order data into Mailchimp audiences. That covers the e-commerce part of the story with a commerce platform similar to Shopify. The Marketing API and webhooks for syncing with your own database are developer building blocks, not maintained integrations, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of Stripe or Shopify integrations, a CDP integration such as Segment, a native product-database connector, an integration directory or catalog, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect the platform to my existing stack — Stripe or Shopify, a CDP like Segment, my product database — with maintained first-party integrations

citations.quote: Mailchimp for Magento is a free integration that adds your customers and their order information to your Mailchimp audience.
Use Magento purchase data to send targeted emails with product recommendations, and turn on e-commerce tracking to measure campaign ROI.
